rationale: V2 native dev: scoring foreground frame presence falls from 0.373640 clean to 0.170481 after full subject blur; union MAE 0.015375 vs origin 0.017240. Test a fixed lower detection threshold and coarse rectangles. Do not tune on held-out data.
scoring: Every actual variant has independent Mask R-CNN detections and MobileSAM inference at threshold 0.3. Coarse rectangles use these same independent detections, never construction masks or clean masks. No prompt text or human labels enter the models.
same_precision_control: Recompute all-pairs from v2 cached CLIP features using the exact dtype and max(0, F.cosine_similarity) semantics of official, with no upper clamp. Preserve v2 float32 ablation separately.
selection: Compare all eight candidates on every dev cohort; retain old negatives. Require nuisance improvement, background response and natural noninferiority jointly. No test data scored until candidate/criteria are frozen.
failures: Retain every candidate/rejection and per-variant failure; never count missing scores as invariance successes.
